using namespace std;
struct num
{
	double z;
	int x;
	int y;
};
struct nam
{
	int y;
	double z;
	int x;
};
const int maxN = 1 * 100000 + 10, mod = (int) 1e9 + 7;
const double ep = 1e-16;

vector<num> v;vector<nam> w;
num nn;
int n;

bool cmp1 (num s1, num s2)
{
	if(s1.z == s2.z)
	{
		if(s1.y < s2.y)
			return 1;
		else
			return 0;
	}
	else if(s1.z < s2.z)
		return 1;
	else 
		return 0;
}
bool cmp2 (nam s1, nam s2)
{
	if(s1.y == s2.y)
	{
		if(s1.x < s2.x)
			return 1;
		else
			return 0;
	}
	else if(s1.y < s2.y)
		return 1;
	else 
		return 0;
}

{
	//ifstream cin("input.txt");
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio (0);
	double h;
	double h2,tel = 0;
	cin >> nn.x >> nn.y >> n;	
	nn.z = 0;
	num t;
	nam sw;
	double dd = (double)nn.x / nn.y;
	fo(i,1,n+1)
	{
		 h = floor((double)dd * i);
		 h2= abs(((double)h / i) - dd);
		 t.x=(int)h;
		 t.y=i;
		 t.z=h2;
		 v.pb(t);
		 h = ceil((double)dd* i);
		 h2= abs(((double)h / i) - dd);
		 t.x=(int)h;
		 t.y=i;
		 t.z=h2;
		 v.pb(t);
	}
	sort(v.begin(),v.end(),cmp1);
	int hh = 0;
	while(abs(tel) < ep && hh < v.size())
	{
		sw.x=v[hh].x;
		sw.y=v[hh].y;
		sw.z=v[hh].z;
		w.pb(sw);
		hh++;
		if(hh <v.size())
			tel = v[0].z - v[hh].z;
	}
	sort(w.begin(),w.end(),cmp2);
	cout << w[0].x << '/' << w[0].y;
	return 0;
}
